Ran per-endpoint rust-vs-reference comparisons (register, post create, RSS, 404, comments/notifications) and used the mismatches to drive fixes, showing coverage-driven gap-closing — but results were not tracked back into a per-subsystem pass/fail ledger.
Extended loop diagnosing a stale-binary/process issue; shows persistence but is infra debugging, not detection of a parity regression or reallocation from a stuck parity mismatch.

reasoning: The agent maintained a genuine running subsystem checklist and updated it as pieces were completed, and used differential endpoint comparisons to find and fix gaps — squarely matching anchor 5. It falls short of 8 because the ledger tracked code-completion rather than harness-backed pass/fail status, and there is no observable regression detection when editing shared code nor explicit recognition of being stuck on a parity mismatch with a tactic change. I place it at 5, with medium confidence given the index-level (no-prose) trajectory.
